verdicts.reason: A keeps related items together: the brand block (logo, Huzzah, Since 1982) and the quote with its attribution. But all the info text is microscopic, 'Helen Keller' is squeezed into a cramped two-line wrap against the quote, the woman image is gone, and there is dead space at the left edge. B scatters the pieces: 'Huzzah' crowds against the oversized logo, 'Since 1982' sits orphaned in the far-right corner away from the brand, and 'Helen Keller' floats far from its quote. B also loses the hero image and its text is just as tiny.
